raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview
Enable fixed-length DSpark speculative decoding with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Prefill Context Parallelism (PCP) on NVIDIA CUDA, extending the standalone PCP path from #59857. Preserve compressor rollback states and keep replicated draft proposals consistent across PCP ranks.


## Claims
- Retain and publish compressor ring tails across PCP ranks so rejected speculative suffixes can resume at an earlier position without losing the predecessor needed by ratio-2 compression.
- Broadcast draft tokens and, for probabilistic drafting, their corresponding logits from PCP rank 0 before target verification. The shared DFlash path also synchronizes confidence values when adaptive verification is enabled; V4.1 PCP still rejects adaptive verification.
- Cover PCP2/4, 0/5/9 speculative tokens, ring capacities 8/16, partial rejection, odd/even accepted prefixes, empty local ranks, and decode-owner changes through the existing compressor regression.


## Validation

```
vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 \
  --language-model-only --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 --prefill-context-parallel-size 2 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}' \
  --max-model-len 32768 --max-num-seqs 16 --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.8 --seed 0 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching --no-swa-bounded-replay \
  --no-async-scheduling -cc.cudagraph_mode=NONE

```
```
lm_eval run \
  --model local-completions \
  --model_args model=deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,tokenized_requests=False \
  --tasks gsm8k \
  --num_fewshot 5 \
  --batch_size 1 \
  --gen_kwargs temperature=0 \
  --output_path /home/chauncey/vllm/downloads/dsv41-flash_profile/gsm8k_lm_eval \
  --log_samples \
  --seed 12345

```
```
|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9333|±  |0.0069|
|     |       |strict-match    |     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9333|±  |0.0069|

```
